name: Green Knight
title: Emerald Warden
summary: Challenge your opponents to a Duel whilst Reflecting Damage back upon those who are unworthy.
lore: Sir Bertilak de Hautdesert was transformed into something more than human by an entity of the faerie courts to test Arthur and his vassals. Gawain eventually passed his trials, but neither that nor the Shattering itself altered the Green Knight’s course. He still considers it his duty to judge the knights of Avalon, and his methods have grown even more lethal.
archetype_description: Increase all stats by 0.5% for each piece of chain armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: If this hero’s HP falls below 50%, place 2 [Mend] on this hero for 1 turns.

skills.name: Curse of Gawain
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 5%HP+55%ATK 3 times. Before attacking, has a 75% chance to place [Drain I] on the target for 3 turns.

skills.description: Steals all Buffs from an enemy then has a 75% chance to place [Taunt] on the target for 3 turns which cannot be blocked or removed. Also place [Retaliate] for 3 turns on this hero.
